detailed_descriptions.en: The board is never far away. When you're done building, drop in and ride your own mountain in third person. Every run is a real, physical ride down the terrain you shaped. Every turn, trick and wipeout is yours. Chase your best times on timed runs and see how you stack up against your guests on the leaderboards. Everything works solo. When you want company, invite a friend into your park with one click from Steam. Build one resort together, then ride the runs you made side by side. Visit the community park to see what other players are up to. Guests arrive as soon as you build for them. They fill your lodges and ride your runs, and your jumps decide whether they stick the landing or wipe out. Take on quests from guests and staff. Your staff keep the resort running, so you can focus on building. No bankruptcy and no fast-forward. Your park grows as guests leave likes, and each level unlocks new buildings. Sculpt bowls, ridgelines and slopes at any time. Tuck lodges into the hillside and lay out lifts, jumps and rails wherever the terrain calls for them. Chat with us! Powder Park is being built by a small team, including one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon. Every building, board, and wipeout is modeled and animated by hand. Come hang out on our Discord, share screenshots of your resort, and tell us what you'd like to see next.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
• The board is never far away. When you're done building, drop in and ride your own mountain in third person.

  • Every run is a real, physical ride down the terrain you shaped. Every turn, trick and wipeout is yours.

  • Chase your best times on timed runs and see how you stack up against your guests on the leaderboards.

  • Everything works solo. When you want company, invite a friend into your park with one click from Steam.

  • Build one resort together, then ride the runs you made side by side.

  • Visit the community park to see what other players are up to.

  • Guests arrive as soon as you build for them. They fill your lodges and ride your runs, and your jumps decide whether they stick the landing or wipe out.

  • Take on quests from guests and staff. Your staff keep the resort running, so you can focus on building.

  • No bankruptcy and no fast-forward. Your park grows as guests leave likes, and each level unlocks new buildings.

  • Sculpt bowls, ridgelines and slopes at any time. Tuck lodges into the hillside and lay out lifts, jumps and rails wherever the terrain calls for them.

Chat with us! Powder Park is being built by a small team, including one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon. Every building, board, and wipeout is modeled and animated by hand. Come hang out on our Discord, share screenshots of your resort, and tell us what you'd like to see next.
